name: Inspecteur des conduites
description: Older tall wiry adult with pale grey dreads in two loose rope bundles, weathered slate speckled skin, long narrow exposed mandibles, healed thin face mark. Sand-worn long sleeveless wrap robe over a fitted linen shirt, shoulder capelet, patinated bronze chest fitting with blue-glass water inspection window. Holds a short articulated inspection probe at waist height and a small bronze mechanical meter in the other hand. Head lowered calmly toward meter.
